threshold_grid.source: User-proposed sensitivity grid, fixed before new annotations; NOT calibrated on original corrections or nearest-neighbor separation

stability_rule: Same per-cell decision across all 25; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE / THRESHOLD_SENSITIVE; PROTOCOL_INVALID has global precedence

matching.scope: same image and annotation_domain, present only
priorities: minimum total quantized normalized centroid cost
lexicographically minimum assigned-right-ID vector in sorted-left-ID order, unmatched last
matching.admissibility: exact squared rational distance <= threshold squared; no epsilon

descriptive_criteria.scope: each image x domain separately; all four must satisfy applicable criteria
descriptive_criteria.origin: Fixed operational conventions, not empirical error calibration

denominators.absent: reported separately, not a true-negative universe

confidence.high: entire region boundary visible, no reconstruction
confidence.medium: partial occlusion/fading, visible envelope localizable; note uncertain boundary
confidence.low: would require reconstruction or alternative-region choice; not allowed with present

kappa_not_estimable: Classification INCONCLUSIVE, not PASS or FAIL; report raw agreement and coverage
uncertainty: DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY; between-folio uncertainty NOT_ESTIMABLE; no Wilson/F1 substitution or object-bootstrap inference
permitted_readiness: READY_FOR_V2_DESIGN / DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY only; does not validate links or select an attribute
reviewer_blinding: Original glyphs/layout visible; no EVA, source warnings, former polygons, diagnostics, threshold grid or H-A3R hypothesis supplied
adjudication: Only after both closures and original metrics; separate consensus dataset; never overwrite raw reviews or agreement
amendment_policy: No amendment after distribution; new version and new prospective collection when criteria change
